notes.title: 《Song of Souls》has now migrated to Unreal Engine 5！
notes.notes:
I am very glad to share with all of you that 'Song of Souls' now has migrated to Unreal Engine 5!
The whole project has successfully moved to UE5 and this patch is build upon UE5. The new engine will provide better quality graphics, and better performance in terms of rendering, light etc.
